d: Bad weather threatens to end the fishing week, but some boats decide to take on Mother Nature's wrath.
As the hunt for blue fin tuna intensifies, the fisherman resort to espionage for information.
It's the fifth week of the season and the entire fleet battle for the most successful fishing spots.
As the fleet charges into the heart of the season, it's a tight race for the coveted title of top-earning boat
It's almost halfway through the bluefin tuna season and the Gloucester fleet has hit a lull in fishing.
With the second half of the season underway, competition amongst the fleet intensifies when tuna become scarce
A new week calls for new techniques as the captains try unconventional methods to hook their next paycheck.
